name: T20Geometry.common_leading_determinant
statement: theorem common_leading_determinant {R : Type} [CommRing R] (q a b c d e f g h i : R) : (q*a)*(q*e)*(q*i)+(q*b)*(q*f)*(q*g)+(q*c)*(q*d)*(q*h)- (q*a)*(q*f)*(q*h)-(q*b)*(q*d)*(q*i)-(q*c)*(q*e)*(q*g) = q^3*(a*e*i+b*f*g+c*d*h-a*f*h-b*d*i-c*e*g)

name: T20Geometry.normalization_factorization
statement: theorem normalization_factorization {R : Type} [CommRing R] (q s d t a b c : R) : q^3*d^3*((s*t*a)*(s*t*b)*(s*t*c)) = (q*s)^3*(d*t)^3*(a*b*c)

name: T20Geometry.normalization_from_units
statement: theorem normalization_from_units {R : Type} [CommRing R] (q s d t a b c : R) (hq : q*s=1) (hd : d*t=1) : q^3*d^3*((s*t*a)*(s*t*b)*(s*t*c))=a*b*c

name: T20Geometry.actual_normalization_constants
statement: theorem actual_normalization_constants : (11 : Fin 101)^3=18 ∧ (18 : Fin 101)*67=95 ∧ (18 : Fin 101)*34=6 ∧ (50 : Fin 101)^2=76
